8.2.4.rationale_en: MHRA guidance mentions post-market surveillance reporting, but does not explicitly reference internal audits or audits as part of QMS monitoring. The regulatory text refers to audits as a potential tool for assessing effectiveness, but not as a formal internal audit requirement.
8.2.4.rationale_zh: MHRA指南提及上市後監督報告，但未明確提及內部審核或審核作為QMS監督的一部分。規範文本提及審核為評估有效性之潛在工具，但非正式內部審核要求。
8.2.4.original_text: The MHRA is responsible for the designation and monitoring of UK conformity assessment bodies. The MHRA is the competent authority for post-market surveillance activity for devices placed on the Northern Ireland market. Where incidents occur in Northern Ireland, these must be reported to the MHRA by the manufacturer through MORE or by healthcare professionals and patients/users through the [YellowCard scheme](https://yellowcard.mhra.gov.uk/).
8.2.4.english_translation: The MHRA is responsible for the designation and monitoring of UK conformity assessment bodies. The MHRA is the competent authority for post-market surveillance activity for devices placed on the Northern Ireland market. Where incidents occur in Northern Ireland, these must be reported to the MHRA by the manufacturer through MORE or by healthcare professionals and patients/users through the [YellowCard scheme](https://yellowcard.mhra.gov.uk/).
8.2.4.semantic_note: Post-market surveillance reporting is required, but internal audit is not explicitly mandated.
